title: Tech Note: Complex Input Types with Web Services

historical_commentary.text: SOAP's complex-type XML input construction, the specific focus of this note, has been broadly superseded by simpler JSON-object-based request bodies in modern REST APIs, which 4D now supports natively, making this note's specific technique largely of historical interest even though the underlying challenge — mapping structured data to an external service's expected wire format — remains a perennial integration concern.
related_updates: REST/JSON APIs have largely replaced SOAP for new web service integrations, and 4D now has native JSON support that simplifies passing structured/complex data compared to SOAP's XML complex types
